note: Illinois DNR park west of Murphysboro on Lake Murphysboro. Big Oak, the electric campground, fills a wooded point; its south and east rim sites (12-14 and 16-26) sit 15-25 m from the shore on mown ground under shade trees, beside a fishing pier. The non-electric sites are gravel pull-offs along the north shore road at Shady Rest and Water Lily. --Claude
